chunks: From 'Ali ibn al-Husayn and Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

The soul of a believer is asked - while it is being washed (for burial): 'Would you be pleased to be returned to the body in which you were?' It replies, 'What do I do with affliction, loss, and grief?'
ai.seo_question: What does the soul of a believer say when asked to return to the body after death?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the state of the believer's soul after death, specifically during the washing of the body. The soul is asked if it wishes to return to the physical body, but it declines, preferring to be free from the trials, loss, and sorrow associated with earthly life.

en.muhajir-b-ali: 32. It has been narrated that 'Ali ibn Al-Husayn and Abu Ja'far (a.s) said:

The soul of a (dead) believer is asked - when it is being washed (for funeral), 'Would it please you to be returned to the body that you resided in?' It would reply, 'What am I to do with (more) afflictions, loss and grief?'
